purpose: Sample accumulated per-link XGMI read/write data and link state during a repeated EP8 interval
capability_probe: verify xgmi is supported rather than reported as N/A on every visible device
config_template:
ROCPROFSYS_USE_AMD_SMI = true
ROCPROFSYS_AMD_SMI_METRICS = xgmi
ROCPROFSYS_ROCM_DOMAINS = hip_runtime_api,memory_copy,hsa_api
preconditions: repeat the identical graph long enough to span many samples because one MegaMoE replay is shorter than the sampling interval
record warmup and measured interval boundaries
pair sampled deltas with exact in-kernel software byte counters
record visible-to-physical GPU and XGMI-link mapping

outputs.information: timestamped AMD-SMI XGMI link width, speed and accumulated read/write samples
tool version, exact command/config, interval, repetitions, scope and raw paths

helps_diagnose: aggregate sampled transfer volume over a long controlled replay
effective link utilization after normalization by a measured ceiling
not_measured: exact bytes for one short dispatch

provenance.notes: Sampling availability depends on hardware/topology; N/A is a failed capability probe, not a zero.
